review_note: Reviewed from the detached 68-job native export. HCSSH + H4 outer product exit: select the explicit CAS(1,1), natural 21, one doublet D1. The H4 SOMO remains H-centered at the actual L2 product geometry and 30 angstrom in avdz-f12 and avtz-f12. Both CAS(3,2) occupied-donor controls give the same reported D1 energy at every anchor; the H SOMO squared overlap is at least 0.9999999999993. Select the formal single-reference radical minimum without an extra filled donor. The one-hole CAS(3,2) comparisons do not establish additional pair-correlation or CASPT2 convergence. Preserve production orbital, state, geometry and connectivity checks, the mapped product-side geometry, the direct CASPT2-F12 avdz/avtz protocol with power 3.7, the separate 30 angstrom asymptote, and the configured COM dividing surfaces and mapped correction-scan anchor. This prepared selection is not installed in retired _r7 or an _r8 run.
